item.title: NIF Dispute, School Promotions, Tawny Gilot
item.ns0:title: NIF Dispute, School Promotions, Tawny Gilot
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, the political firestorm intensifies as the opposition demands answers and threatens legal action over the disappearance of more than $265 million from the National Investment Fund. We investigate the growing tension within the education sector as school leaders warn of a potential strike just weeks before the new term and bring you the details of a 25-year prison sentence handed down in a tragic case of betrayal. Our team joins a grieving community honoring the life of a beloved musician lost in the North Andros plane crash while highlighting the start of the vat-free shopping holiday for parents. Plus, we clarify the latest national health statistics on STIs and track the government’s regional mission to modernize the nation's building approval process.
